verdict.rationale: Railway's site says every pull request gets its own preview and offers unlimited environments, so the core per-PR preview workflow is directly claimed. The evidence is marketing-level only. It does not show that previews cover the full stack (databases and multiple services) or that they are torn down automatically on merge. Missing for 10: documented automatic teardown on PR merge or close, explicit evidence that previews include the full stack (databases and services), in-depth first-party docs on PR environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
